title: MOCHA: Multi-Objective Chebyshev Annealing for Agent Skill Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2605.19330v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLM agents organize behavior through skills -- structured natural-language specifications that govern how an agent reasons, retrieves, and responds. Unlike monolithic prompts, skills are multi-field artifacts with platform limits: descriptions are indexed for routing, instruction bodies are loaded into a shared context window, and every extra line costs the agent context it could spend elsewhere. Skill optimization is therefore inherently multi-objective: a skill should be accurate and economical at once. Existing prompt optimizers collapse these goals into a single score, and we find that this makes them stall: in most of their runs, 1000 rollouts yield zero progress over the seed skill. We introduce MOCHA (Multi-Objective CHebyshev Annealing), which selects skills to improve by Chebyshev scalarization and accepts improvements that expand the Pareto front, annealing from exploration to exploitation. translated_title: MOCHA：面向智能体技能优化的多目标切比雪夫退火方法
translated_abstract: LLM 智能体通过“技能”来组织其行为——技能是结构化的自然语言规范，规定了智能体如何进行推理、检索和响应。与单体式提示词不同，技能是受平台限制约束的多字段产物：描述字段被索引用于路由，指令主体被加载到共享的上下文窗口中，每多一行都会消耗智能体本可用于其他地方的上下文资源。因此，技能优化本质上是多目标问题：技能应当同时具备准确性和经济性。现有的提示词优化器将这些目标压缩为单一分数，我们发现这会导致它们停滞不前：在其大多数运行中，1000 次 rollout 相较种子技能毫无进展。我们提出了 MOCHA（Multi-Objective CHebyshev Annealing，多目标切比雪夫退火），该方法通过切比雪夫标量化来选择需要改进的技能，并接受能够扩展帕累托前沿的改进，从而从探索阶段逐步退火至利用阶段。切比雪夫标量化……
tldr: 提出 MOCHA 方法，通过切比雪夫标量化选择改进对象并以扩展帕累托前沿为接受准则，从探索退火到利用，实现智能体技能在准确性与上下文经济性之间的多目标优化，克服了现有单分数提示词优化器易停滞的问题。
en_tdlr: MOCHA formulates agent skill optimization as a multi-objective problem, using Chebyshev scalarization and Pareto front expansion with annealing to jointly optimize skill accuracy and context economy, overcoming the stalling behavior of existing single-score prompt optimizers.
